alignments.note: Genitive name rendered of me Paul; the case preposition and the supplied appositional pronoun are its helpers and the name is the head (rules 7, 17).
Article displaced by the first-person possessive adjective (rule 54).
Possessive adjective → mine own, headed on the possessive word.
Dative noun with its case preposition with, discontinuous around the possessive; no article carries a determiner here, so the preposition stays with the noun (rules 15, 21).

review_notes: own is kept inside the possessive adjective's unit, ἐμῇ being the only token it can answer to.
